public_rationale: The contemporary test records document recurring failures in how GPT-4 selected operations, invoked tools, and handled results. Examples involve both Wolfram Alpha and Code Interpreter. This supports the ordinary behavioral reading of the claim. It does not establish that tool use usually failed, or that GPT-4 lacked useful tool skills.
limitations: The main evidence comes from the study underlying the post, rather than an independent replication.
The study used a small, deliberately constructed collection and published edited outputs.
No numerical reliability threshold was specified.
